coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall sweep only. Production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative. No content approval, publication, schedule change, or task disabling.

Twelve targeted web searches returned without search errors: 4 sole/last/full-service grocery loss, 3 canceled disaster-related food distributions, 2 abrupt pantry/bank service losses, 3 official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

No locally reported or official new qualifying access interruption was verified with event/publication timing inside the bounded window. Not proof of nationwide absence; recently issued/unindexed local notices may be missed.

Older 2025 SNAP shutdown articles surfaced despite recency filters; these do not evidence any October 2026 interruption and were excluded. Historical 2017 grocery context and general government pages were likewise excluded.

Excluded generic EBT troubleshooting from February 2026 and future-looking program information without confirmed current benefit outage. No verified storm-related distribution cancellation or new pantry shutdown was found.
No donation drives, resource guides, routine program promotion, generic inflation articles, stale incidents, or duplicate signals admitted.
